== Description ==

Two players shake hands across a Friday Cube Draft table at the [[2025 World Championship]] in SeaTac, Washington, on 3 October 2025. Neither face is fully shown.

== Source and credit ==

* '''Source:''' Star Wars CCG Slack, #2025-world-championship-seattle, Teacher, 3 October 2025 (13:30 PDT): "#GLHF". Original file name: IMG_8090.jpg (4032×3024); Slack file id F09JSKZH8J0.
* '''Shared by:''' Teacher (Slack)
* '''Date:''' 3 October 2025 (Slack post date).
* '''Identification:''' Both faces are cropped/partial; the player on the right wears a black UWL hoodie matching [[Logan Pietig]] in [[:File:2025 World Championship Logan Pietig evening 3 October.jpg]].
Unknown faces are listed on [[Unidentified event photographs]]; if you recognise someone, please say so on the [https://swccg.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=4 SWCCG Forum] or this File's Talk page.
